source.name: Spicer Designs Accountant template
source.rightsEvidence: The official downloadable template is licensed under Creative Commons Attribution 4.0. The source license is retained in this dossier and the official preview retains the required Spicer Designs footer attribution.

provenance.capture: Full-page screenshots from the official live accountant preview at 1440x900 and 390x844 after complete-page scrolling. The official preview and downloadable HTML release use the same design. All visible image elements loaded; document width matched both viewports.
provenance.diagnostics: The source opens with a deadline rail and calendar, then fee tiers, switching, enquiry triggers, software/client-fit, FAQs and contact. Demo deadlines, fees, staff, reviews and tax claims are not transferable.
provenance.attribution: Spicer Designs, CC BY 4.0. Required attribution remains visible in the captured footer. Internal visual reference only; do not ship source identity, copy, code, prices or hero artwork.

referenceDna.annotatedDescription: A deadline-led accounting practice opens with a narrow filing-deadline rail above compact navigation. A practical proposition pairs fixed-fee clarity with immediate fee and switching routes. A filing calendar follows, then a three-tier comparison with inclusions/exclusions, a switch-accountant walkthrough, common enquiry triggers, software/client fit, proof, FAQs, and an enquiry form. Cream/green surfaces, compact table labels, and bright active states make the page practical rather than corporate. Every sample amount, date, accountant, review and claim is fictitious template content.

heroGeometry.mode: deadline rail above a photo-backed accountant promise with two decision links
heroGeometry.alignment: compact fee message on the left and subdued accounting-workspace image on the right
heroGeometry.viewport: deadline context, fee path and switch path fit the first desktop scene

navigationGeometry.mode: deadline status rail with anchored fee, switching and contact navigation
navigationGeometry.placement: thin status line first, compact wordmark and navigation below
navigationGeometry.mobile: keep the latest deadline context and contact route without squeezing desktop links

typography.display: bold clean sans with compact uppercase financial labels
typography.scale: oversized short promise, compact dates/fees, readable explanatory notes

palette.contrastIntent: dates and actions receive accent; tables and fee notes keep accessible text contrast

imageTreatment.mode: subdued accounting-desk still life rather than stock people
imageTreatment.crop: wide hero with quiet image contrast, later small documentary details
imageTreatment.focalPoint: the calendar and fee structure carry primary visual weight; image is secondary

servicePresentation.pattern: chronological filing calendar followed by transparent fixed-fee tiers and switching guidance
servicePresentation.interaction: calendar filters by business type only when dates and applicability are verified

ctaPlacement.primary: consultation/fee route beside the opening proposition
ctaPlacement.early: calendar and fee tiers appear before firm-history copy

motion.primitive: small calendar filters that explain obligations for a selected client type
motion.reducedMotion: complete static table without motion dependency

rules: stack each calendar row as date, obligation, applicability and status
stack fee tiers and keep inclusions/exclusions adjacent
show jurisdiction next to each date

prohibitedPatterns: source brand, fees, staff, dates, services, reviews, advice or hero art
deadlines copied without an active official jurisdictional source
invented pricing, savings, switching time, tax outcomes or response promises
fake countdowns or live compliance status
unverified registrations, software partnerships or client logos
generic card wall replacing the calendar and fee logic

requiredSignatureElements.description: concise, fact-checked deadline context before primary navigation
dated obligations with verified jurisdiction and applicability
client-approved pricing or honest fee-setting explanation
practical switching process based on actual firm operations

acceptanceChecks: every date is current and tied to jurisdiction and applicability
fees and inclusions are client supplied
calendar and fee paths are visible before long firm history
source content and art are excluded from deliverables

review.scope: official CC BY 4.0 package, paired captures, calendar mechanics and demo-content exclusions
